milestone.name: P4 release assurance
milestone.objective: Produce current release evidence and establish whether version 1.1.1 can pass trusted internal production gates.

lastCompletedWork.summary: Prepared and verified the unsigned candidate and committed-HEAD CI evidence, then blocked REM-0205 because the dirty candidate is untested, trusted signing and independent review are absent, and hosted source safeguards are disabled.

decisions.rationale: Its clean-candidate, signature, independent-review, and production-verification acceptance criteria do not pass.

decisions.decision: Accept committed-HEAD CI as historical evidence only.
decisions.rationale: Run 33577680101 proves nine combinations for 4f967865 but not the dirty candidate changes.
Read-only GitHub evidence proves main protection/rulesets and multiple hosted security controls are absent or disabled.
The approved autonomous defaults prohibit commit, push, hosted settings changes, signing, release, and publication.

validation.evidence: 150 checksum-covered files, CycloneDX SBOM, and in-toto provenance verify.
Validated GitHub artifact from run 33577680101 contains all nine Windows/Linux/macOS Node 22/24/26 passes for 4f967865.
Clarification, architecture, security, deployment, readiness, and CI evidence reports validate.
Dirty worktree, missing trusted signature, missing independent review, and failed production verification.
Blocked schema-v3 execution validates against immutable PSO-124 snapshot 040dad9a.

worktree.attribution: This handoff attributes only P4 evidence and continuity reports; source and unrelated existing changes remain untouched.

blockers: The dirty candidate is not reproducible or remotely tested.
Trusted signature and independent review are absent.
ARCF-0205 and SECF-0205 hosted safeguards are unresolved.
pendingApprovals: Trusted signing by a controlled identity.
Independent review by a distinct qualified reviewer.
limitations: No commit, push, merge, tag, signing, deployment, publication, Azure mutation, workflow dispatch, or hosted setting mutation occurred.
Remote-only refs and unreachable objects were not scanned.

nextAction.action: Resume P4 after approving a reviewed clean commit/push and hosted-control remediation and assigning distinct trusted signing and independent-review identities.
prerequisites: Do not self-sign or self-approve independent review.
Keep release, publication, deployment, and Azure mutation prohibited until separately approved.
